steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ without changing the title.
Apply the RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is available.
Add the first product from family F1.
Set the first product's location to Plant Name.
Confirm the first product was added.
Confirm the product's automatically selected variant.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [RFQ] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - Plant Name

steps.note: Verify the automatic single-product RFQ title before adding the second family.
Add the second product from a different family.
Set the second product's location to the same Plant Name.
Confirm the second product was added.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [RFQ] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB & more - Plant Name

steps.note: Remove the second product while the title remains automatic.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [RFQ] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB - Plant Name

steps.note: Verify the title updates after removing a row.
Re-add the second product to restore the mixed-family condition.

args.label: Enter the title of this event
args.value: [RFQ] CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB & more - Plant Name

steps.note: Verify the mixed-family title updates again after re-adding the row.
